fusions.name: Taste the Trail
fusions.desc: Flicks your tongue at a target up to 6 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, with a 40% chance of [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then bites with your weapon for 20 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Downwind Together
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. While veiled you move 11% faster and enemies notice you 60% later. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Heel-Trained Monitor
fusions.desc: A bonded monitor follows at your heel and fights beside you, biting enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.3 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
